Example 15. How many times will minute hand and hour hand coincide? Find the times.

Solution: Let minute hand and hour hand coincide at the time $x : y$. We need to remember that $x$ ($x = 0, 1, \dots 11$ where $0$ means $12$) is always an integer but $y$ may not be. We know, minute hand runs 12 times faster than the hour hand. At time $x$ the hour hand is exactly on the $x$ and minute hand is on the $12$.
